title: Use a required field rule
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Use a required field rule. Post {} and inspect the automatic 400 response.
introduction: ApiController checks validation attributes. A valid POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"} reaches this action.
learningObjectives: Use a required field rule with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Use a required field rule

blocks.text: The required attribute is checked before the action. A valid title reaches Ok; an absent title gives 400.
Post {} and inspect the automatic 400 response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Required checks presence; add more rules for your actual needs.
